name: Ask Claude
tagline: Answers with Claude, an AI model by Anthropic
about: Message me a question, or add me to a group and mention me with @. In a group I receive the messages of members who said OK to me, and I answer only the ones that mention me or start with /ask. Your question, your name and @handle, and my earlier answer when you reply to one go to Anthropic's API to write the answer. Nothing else does.
retention: This bot stores none of your messages and logs no words; its own answers are kept encrypted for 14 days so a phone that missed one can ask again. Anthropic deletes API inputs and outputs within 30 days, unless they are flagged under its Usage Policy (then up to 2 years), a law requires longer, or the operator has a zero data retention agreement.
